conditions: Every decisive result names the exact artifact, platform, configuration, evidence, and stop condition.
Failures retain their first divergent checkpoint or bounded unsupported dependency.
Evidence can be regenerated without granting deployment authority.
effect: Release decisions remain inspectable and target-specific instead of hiding failures inside aggregate confidence or schedule pressure.
failure_boundary: A checklist, metric average, approval label, or passing result that cannot reproduce its observation is insufficient release evidence.
